Some properties of copper are listed.
1
It conducts electricity.
2
It conducts heat.
3
It is ductile.
4
It has a high melting point.
Which properties of copper make it useful as a cooking pan?
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 3
C
2 and 4
D
3 and 4
subject: Chemistry
